visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: equal photos, natural aspect (3:2 on source), 16px radius
visualCharacteristics.structure: row of images, optional caption under each
visualCharacteristics.columns: 3 in a row from 768px (follows image count, max 4), stacked below 768px

contentPattern: Image row: one row with one image per cell (typically 3 photos). Optional text in a cell becomes a caption below that image. Heading, paragraph and bullet list above it are default content.
